name: Zoho CRM
shortInfo: Zoho CRM helps you create, manage, and organize data in a way that drives sales and revenue.
brief: The Zoho CRM Reverse ETL connector enables streaming data from a user determined warehouse to the Zoho CRM platform in an automated manner.
about:
Zoho CRM helps helps businesses engage with customers, convert more leads, and grow their revenue by closing more deals.

Check more about Zoho CRM api doc [here](https://www.zoho.com/crm/developer/docs/api/v5/).
availableSync:
